info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Inquiry API
info.description: The Product Inventory Inquiry API enables users to access real-time information about product inventory items within specific banking channels. This API supports operations that retrieve details about available inventory, including stock levels, item descriptions, and pricing. It is primarily utilized by banking institutions and e-commerce platforms to ensure accurate product availability data is displayed to customers. Developers can leverage this API to create seamless user experiences by integrating dynamic product inventory insights into applications.

get.summary: Retrieve Product Inventory Items for a Specific Channel
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all product inventory items associated with a specific channel. It is essential for managing and displaying inventory for various sales channels.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving product inventory items specific to a channel. This body is structured to align with the required schema for the GET operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested inventory items.
